_meta.method: sysuse sp500 with m q w tc yr generated from date (data.gen_cmds). histogram: twoway__histogram_gen <v> [if], density|frequency [width() start() bin() discrete] gen(), bars placed at floor((x - start)/width). kdensity: r(bwidth) of kdensity <v>, nograph, and twoway__kdensity_gen <v> [if], gen() n(5) range() [bwidth()]. lpoly: lpoly close <v> [if], nograph gen() n(5) bwidth(). fits: fracpoly: regress close date with predict double; regress close m; regress date close. kpi: summarize <v> [if] [in], detail, value and display text. axis_labels: twoway <cmd> exported to SVG, tick texts read back.

data.gen_cmds: sysuse sp500, clear; keep date close; gen m = mofd(date); format m %tm; gen q = qofd(date); format q %tq; gen w = wofd(date); format w %tw; gen double tc = cofd(date) + 3600000*mod(_n,24); format tc %tc; gen yr = 1950 + mod(_n,40); format yr %ty

fp:td.cmd: fracpoly: regress close date; predict double

tc:default.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen tc , density gen(zh zx, replace)

tc:w7d.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen tc , density start(1294012800000) width(604800000) gen(zh zx, replace)

td:bin10.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen date , density bin(10) gen(zh zx, replace)

td:default.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen date , density gen(zh zx, replace)

td:default:fixedgrid:if.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen date if close>=1200, density start(14977) width(24.2) gen(zh zx, replace)

td:default:if.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen date if close>=1200, density gen(zh zx, replace)

td:discrete.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen date , density discrete gen(zh zx, replace)

td:frequency.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen date , frequency gen(zh zx, replace)

td:w30s14975.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen date , density width(30) start(14975) gen(zh zx, replace)

td:w30s14975:if.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen date if close>=1200, density width(30) start(14975) gen(zh zx, replace)

tm:default.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen m , density gen(zh zx, replace)

tm:w2s492.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen m , density width(2) start(492) gen(zh zx, replace)

tw:default.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen w , density gen(zh zx, replace)

ty:default.cmd: twoway__histogram_gen yr , density gen(zh zx, replace)

td:range:bw10.cmd: twoway__kdensity_gen date , gen(zd zx) n(5) range(14900 15400) bwidth(10)

td:range:bw10:if.cmd: twoway__kdensity_gen date if close>=1200, gen(zd zx) n(5) range(14900 15400) bwidth(10)

td:range:default.cmd: twoway__kdensity_gen date , gen(zd zx) n(5) range(14900 15400)

td:range:default:if.cmd: twoway__kdensity_gen date if close>=1200, gen(zd zx) n(5) range(14900 15400)

tm:range:bw1.cmd: twoway__kdensity_gen m , gen(zd zx) n(5) bwidth(1) range(490 505)

tc:bw30d.cmd: lpoly close tc , nograph gen(zx zs) n(5) bwidth(2592000000)

td:bw30.cmd: lpoly close date , nograph gen(zx zs) n(5) bwidth(30)

td:bw30:if.cmd: lpoly close date if close>=1200, nograph gen(zx zs) n(5) bwidth(30)

tm:bw2.cmd: lpoly close m , nograph gen(zx zs) n(5) bwidth(2)
